• Day 2 (Jan 7): Technical Paper Tracks (OBE Metrics & AI in Educational Evaluation), Dean Panel Discussion
• Day 3 (Jan 8): Best Paper Presentations, Policy Roadmap Synthesis, Valedictory & Awards Ceremony

event_content_sections.title: Research Tracks & Scope
event_content_sections.content:

• Track 4: Inclusive Curriculum Design & Special Education Integration

events.name: Conference on History in the Age of AI
events.description: Dedicated research symposium exploring digital humanities at the intersection of historiography and computational technology. Evaluates how large language models, computer vision for manuscript restoration, and geospatial historical GIS tools are redefining archival reconstruction, while critically examining algorithmic bias, digital hallucination, and historical revisionism.

organizations.name: School of Liberal & Creative Arts (Social Sciences & Languages)

subcategories.name: School of Liberal and Creative Arts (Social Sciences and Languages)

event_content_sections.title: Symposium Itinerary
event_content_sections.content:
• 09:00 AM — Registration & Opening Address: The Computational Historian
• 10:30 AM — Track 1: Digital Archival Retrieval & Ancient Script OCR
• 01:30 PM — Track 2: Historiographical Epistemology & Language Models
• 03:30 PM — Panel Discussion: Deepfakes, Hallucination, and Historical Evidence
• 04:30 PM — Concluding Remarks & Certificate Handover

event_content_sections.title: Symposium Topics
event_content_sections.content:
• AI in Epigraphy, Paleography, and Ancient Manuscript Restoration
• Geospatial Historical Analysis using GIS and Neural Models
• Cultural Heritage Preservation via 3D Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs)
• Ethical Historiography: Countering Algorithmic Bias and Revisionism

events.name: International Conference on Voices, Visions, and Values: Rethinking English Literature in a Changing World
events.description: International literary dialogue examining contemporary re-readings of global anglophone literature against shifting socio-political, environmental, and technological landscapes. Emphasizes subaltern narratives, post-humanist literary criticism, ecocriticism, translation studies, and new digital narrative forms.

events.name: International Conference on Next-Gen Computing, Artificial Intelligence and Pervasive Systems (NGCAPS-2027)
events.description: Flagship computing conference congregating researchers, software engineers, and AI specialists. Focuses on pervasive distributed intelligence, edge inference, neuromorphic architectures, federated computing models, IoT mesh protocols, and high-assurance cybersecurity in ubiquitous computing environments.
